pages.text: Withered Forest, Ashen Wastes, Marrow Thicket and vanilla biomes. Below lies the $(l)Withered Champion$(), a duellist: his dashes follow a marked line, and in his last phase he vanishes and strikes from behind, in the dark.

A ruined necropolis above a dark $(l)labyrinth$(). Long corridors carry marked dashes: step aside. Crossroads bring darkness and ambushes behind your back: a circle gives you time to turn. The treasures lie in the deepest dead ends.
